content_sections.heading: Contract Period
content_sections.text: The appointments are temporary and contractual. The contract will continue for up to 11 months or until completion of the relevant scheme, whichever occurs earlier. Selection under this notification does not provide a right to claim permanent government employment.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification indicates that applications and supporting certificates will be scrutinized according to the prescribed qualification, experience, communal rotation and priority category. Application and certificate scrutiny Shortlisting based on eligibility and applicable priority rules Interview and original-document verification, if called Final selection by the District Health Society If two candidates obtain equal marks, preference will be given to the older candidate based on date of birth.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kanyakumari DHS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Kanyakumari district official website . Download the District Health Society application form. Clearly write the name of the post applied for in the application form. Enter personal, educational, community, address and experience details. Affix a recent passport-size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of all applicable certificates. Submit the application in person or send it through Speed Post. Ensure that the application reaches the prescribed address before the notified deadline and closing time. Applications that do not mention the post name or do not contain the required certificates will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Completed application form with recent photograph Birth certificate, SSLC certificate or HSC certificate as proof of date of birth Educational qualification certificates and all mark sheets Updated medical, nursing or professional council registration certificate, where applicable Tamil-language qualification certificate Nativity certificate issued by the Revenue Department Aadhaar card Community certificate Experience certificates for posts requiring experience Valid driving licence for applicable posts Priority-category certificate, where applicable Character certificate issued within the prescribed period Disability certificate, where applicable Transgender or destitute-widow certificate, where applicable No Objection Certificate, where applicable First-generation graduate certificate, where priority is claimed Applicants must produce the original documents during the interview or document-verification process.

content_sections.heading: Priority Categories
content_sections.text: The notification provides priority according to the applicable Tamil Nadu Government rules for eligible candidates such as: Young people who lost both parents due to COVID-19 or another reason Candidates who studied in Tamil medium in Tamil Nadu government schools Eligible inter-caste married couples Ex-servicemen and eligible dependants of serving or former military personnel Persons discharged from Tamil Nadu State Government service Candidates claiming a priority category must attach the relevant certificate issued by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post name must be clearly mentioned in the application. Separate applications should be submitted when applying for different posts. Applications must contain copies of all required certificates. Late applications will be rejected. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The number of vacancies may change. Original documents must be produced when requested. The decision of the Chairman, District Health Society, will be final regarding appointment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Kanyakumari DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 81 temporary contractual vacancies under 21 post categories.

faq.question: Q2. Which post has the highest number of vacancies?
faq.answer: MPHW Male/Health Inspector Grade-II has 29 vacancies, followed by Auxiliary Nurse Midwife/Urban Health Nurse with 22 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The monthly salary ranges from Rs.10,000 for Attender to Rs.63,000 for Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline, either in person or through Speed Post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the contract period?
faq.answer: The appointment will be for up to 11 months or until completion of the scheme, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Health Inspector Grade-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 with Biology or Botany and Zoology, studied Tamil at SSLC level and completed the prescribed two-year MPHW Male or Health Inspector training.

faq.question: Q7. Where should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted to the Executive Secretary, District Health Society/District Health Officer, District Health Office, Krishnankovil, Nagercoil - 629001.
